intro: Nicaragua exports gold, coffee, beef and clothes.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Gold has become the top export, followed by beef, coffee and textiles. Money from Nicaraguans abroad is a large share of income.

chapters.title: Rum
text: Flor de Caña rum is a famous Nicaraguan brand.
